jobgether-jobgether:lever:0bf265b6-95ac-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Netherlands. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led busin

Requirements Professional experience: 5+ years of experience building and shipping software products in professional engineering environments. Backend expertise: Strong experience designing and developing backend systems, with significant hands-on experience in Python preferred. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9fcb9e99-4957-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Design Engineer based in Ireland. As a Product Design Engineer, you’ll combine product design and front-end engineering to take ideas from early exploration through to production. You’ll shape what is worth building, prototype rapidly, and personally turn strong concepts into polished digital experiences. Working within a product squad, you’ll partner closely with software engineers while owning the experience and interface layer. A major focus will be designing human-centred experiences for AI-native products, where users supervise, review, correct, and authorise work performed by intelligent agents. You’ll have substantial influence over product decisions rather than simply executing finished specifications. This is an ideal role for a multidisciplinary builder who values speed, craft, product judgment, and the ability to ship. Explore product opportunities through user research, experimentation, prototyping, and iterative design to identify the strongest solutions. Carry product concepts through to production-ready front-end experiences, combining design decisions and implementation within the same workflow. Help define what is worth building by engaging with users, challenging assumptions, validating problems, and shaping scope with the product squad. Design and build intuitive supervisory interfaces for AI-native workflows, including triage queues, confidence and citation patterns, briefings, and other decision-support experiences. Use AI tools throughout the product development lifecycle, including research, design, prototyping, development, and testing. Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, applying strong product and design judgment rather than relying on automated results without review. Collaborate closely with software engineers responsible for the underlying systems and ensure the final experience works effectively with the technical architecture. Take ownership of front-end quality, including performance, accessibility, responsive behaviour, cross-device compatibility, and perceived speed. Continuously iterate on products based on user feedback, technical constraints, and real-world usage. Deliver polished, production-ready experiences that balance usability, functionality, technical feasibility, and visual quality. Requirements: Proven experience designing and building front-end products through to production, with ownership of both the experience and implementation. Strong design judgment and visual/product taste, with the ability to distinguish genuinely excellent experiences from interfaces that are merely functional. Strong product instinct and the ability to challenge assumptions, reduce unnecessary scope, and validate ideas with real users. Fluency in modern web development and front-end engineering practices. Demonstrated experience using AI tooling across multiple stages of product development, including research, design, prototyping, coding, and testing. Strong understanding of AI limitations and failure modes, with the ability to identify when AI-generated output appears correct but is not. Experience creating data-rich, complex, or high-stakes interfaces for demanding professional users. Ability to communicate credibly with domain experts and translate complex workflows into clear, effective product experiences. Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, performance, and cross-device behaviour. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary product squad alongside software engineers and other stakeholders. Candidates may come from design, engineering, or multidisciplinary backgrounds; the key requirement is the ability to design, build, and ship high-quality products. Benefits: Fully remote working opportunity within the UK or Europe. Opportunity to combine product design and front-end engineering without traditional handoffs between design and

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e2533af0-c12c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Legal Counsel, Payments & Fintech based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to provide strategic legal guidance at the intersection of payments, financial services, technology, and global digital commerce. You will advise on complex payment processing operations, regulatory requirements, commercial agreements, and market expansion initiatives. Working closely with product, technology, business operations, and leadership teams, you will help translate complex legal requirements into practical, business-oriented solutions. The role covers a broad international regulatory landscape, including money transmission, AML, sanctions, card network rules, and emerging financial technologies. You will also play an important role in identifying legal risks early and supporting the development of compliant payment products. This is an ideal opportunity for a commercially minded attorney who enjoys working in a fast-paced, innovative, and highly collaborative environment. Draft, review, and negotiate agreements with payment service providers, acquirers, card networks, payment facilitators, banks, financial institutions, vendors, licensors, and strategic partners. Advise on end-to-end payment processing activities, including new payment methods and provider onboarding, global money flows, settlement structures, chargebacks, refunds, reserves, and holdback arrangements. Provide legal guidance on KYC/KYB, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, customer due diligence, and related compliance processes across multiple markets. Support the legal and regulatory aspects of entering new markets, including licensing analysis, entity structuring, and the establishment and maintenance of legal entities where required. Advise business and technology leaders on the legal implications of strategic initiatives, payment strategies, product launches, and other commercial decisions. Monitor developments in laws and regulations affecting payments, digital commerce, and emerging technologies, including cryptocurrency, blockchain, NFTs, and decentralized finance. Analyze new and proposed regulations and communicate their potential impact on money movement, payment strategies, products, and ongoing business initiatives. Draft and negotiate commercial, financial services, technology, licensing, vendor, and partnership agreements while ensuring alignment with business objectives and legal requirements. Partner closely with product, technology, operations, and management teams to develop compliant payment products and services that support commercial objectives. Identify potential legal and regulatory challenges proactively and develop practical strategies to mitigate risks. Manage multiple legal matters and competing priorities while delivering high-quality advice within demanding timelines. Provide additional legal support and strategic guidance across broader business initiatives as needed. Requirements Licensed to practice law in the United States and in good standing. At least 5 years of legal experience in fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or a closely related field. Demonstrated expertise in payment systems and familiarity with U.S. and international regulatory frameworks, including money transmission, BSA/AML, PSD2, MiCA, and card network rules. Strong understanding of payment processing, financial regulation, compliance requirements, and global digital commerce. Proven ability to provide practical, commercially focused legal advice in a fast-paced and constantly evolving business environment. Excellent drafting, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with experience handling complex commercial agreements. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex legal and regulatory matters clearly to non-legal stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effective

Ability to work independently with high attention to detail and consistency.
